SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 1048576;

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_ubndtp (
    task_id,
    loai_nhiem_vu,
    hinh_thuc_giao,

    ben_giao_id,
    ben_giao_name,

    ben_nhan_id,
    ben_nhan_name,

    ten_task,
    nhom_nhiem_vu,
    stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
    van_ban_giao,
    noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

    to_chuc_dang_chu_tri,
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    ngay_bat_dau,
    thoi_han,
    ngay_hoan_thanh,

    tinh_trang,
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    ld_ubnd,
    ld_van_phong_ubnd,
    ban_chuyen_mon,
    chuyen_vien_theo_doi,
    sync_date
)

SELECT
    b.task_id,
    b.loai_nhiem_vu,
    b.hinh_thuc_giao,

    b.ben_giao_id,
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE d.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.ben_giao_id, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_giao_name,

    b.final_ben_nhan_id AS ben_nhan_id,
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE d.id = CAST(
            CASE 
                /* Nếu thuộc 490.695.1558.% thì lấy ID của cấp 4 */
                WHEN b.final_ben_nhan_id LIKE '490.695.1558.%'
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.final_ben_nhan_id, '.', 4), '.', -1)
                ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.final_ben_nhan_id, '.', -1)
            END AS UNSIGNED
        )
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_nhan_name,

    b.ten_task,
    b.nhom_nhiem_vu,
    b.stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
    rv.van_ban_giao,
    b.noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

    /* 1. TỔ CHỨC ĐẢNG CHỦ TRÌ */
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE d.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.dept_to_chuc_dang, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS to_chuc_dang_chu_tri,

    /* 2. LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ VÀ CHUYÊN VIÊN (THUỘC 490.698%) */
    ldcv.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    b.ngay_bat_dau,
    b.thoi_han,
    b.ngay_hoan_thanh,

    b.tinh_trang,
    rp.Content AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    /* 3. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND: Đúng đích danh cấp '490.698', chức danh Lãnh đạo, Level = 2
       Chức vụ hiển thị: ông Vũ Đại Thắng = 'Chủ tịch', còn lại = 'Phó Chủ tịch' */
    (
        SELECT 
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                        CASE
                            WHEN TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname) LIKE '%Vũ Đại Thắng%' THEN 'Chủ tịch'
                            ELSE 'Phó Chủ tịch'
                        END,
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), '')
                    )
                ), ''
            )
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
            ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
        WHERE tu.TaskId = b.task_id
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, ''), u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
          AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
          AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
        ORDER BY tu.Role DESC, tu.Id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ld_ubnd,

    /* LÃNH ĐẠO VĂN PHÒNG:
       - Check qlnv_task_user của nhiệm vụ, nếu có user thuộc ban LIKE '490.698.752%' thì lấy user đó
       - Ưu tiên phòng ban thật của user (u.DepartmentPath), fallback tu.DepartmentId
     */
    (
        SELECT 
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), '')
                    )
                ), ''
            )
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
            ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
        WHERE tu.TaskId = b.task_id
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE '490.698.752'
        ORDER BY tu.Role DESC, tu.Id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ld_van_phong_ubnd,

    /* 4. BAN CHUYÊN MÔN: Phòng của chuyên viên theo dõi.
       Chỉ lấy khi là Nhiệm vụ giao VÀ người tạo thuộc Văn phòng UBND '490.698.752%' */
    CASE 
        WHEN b.loai_nhiem_vu = 'Nhiệm vụ giao'
             AND b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon LIKE '490.698.752%'
        THEN COALESCE(
                 NULLIF((
                     SELECT d.name 
                     FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
                     WHERE d.id = CASE
                             WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                             THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                             ELSE NULL
                           END
                       AND d.IsDelete = 0 
                     LIMIT 1
                 ), ''),
                 NULLIF(b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon, '')
             )
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS ban_chuyen_mon,

    /* 5. CHUYÊN VIÊN THEO DÕI: Lấy theo CreateUser.
       Chỉ lấy khi là Nhiệm vụ giao VÀ người tạo thuộc Văn phòng UBND '490.698.752%' */
    CASE 
        WHEN b.loai_nhiem_vu = 'Nhiệm vụ giao'
             AND b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon LIKE '490.698.752%'
        THEN NULLIF((
            SELECT u.eGovUserFullname 
            FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
            WHERE u.eGovUserId = b.CreateUser 
            ORDER BY u.Id DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), '')
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS chuyen_vien_theo_doi,
    '${sync_ts}' AS sync_date

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.TaskId AS task_id,
        t.AssignDepartment AS ben_giao_id,
        t.AssignUser,
        t.CreateUser,
        t.TargetDepartment AS TargetDepartment_Goc,

        /* LOẠI NHIỆM VỤ */
        CASE
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ giao'

            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
                 AND (t.TargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ nhận'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS loai_nhiem_vu,

        /* HÌNH THỨC GIAO */
        CASE
            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
                 AND t.TargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') 
            THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'

            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment NOT IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN tu_check.has_user_dept = 1 THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                    ELSE 'Không qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                END

            ELSE NULL
        END AS hinh_thuc_giao,

        /* ID BÊN NHẬN */
        CASE 
            /* Nhánh 490.695.1558.% chuẩn hóa về cấp 4 */
            WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695.1558.%'
            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)

            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN (CHAR_LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)

                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1307%' 
                         AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                         AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                         AND (CHAR_LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)

                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment
                END
            ELSE t.TargetDepartment
        END AS final_ben_nhan_id,

        /* TỔ CHỨC ĐẢNG CHỦ TRÌ PATH */
        CASE 
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN (CHAR_LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)

                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1307%' 
                         AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                         AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                         AND (CHAR_LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)

                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment
                END
            ELSE t.TargetDepartment
        END AS dept_to_chuc_dang,

        /* BAN CHUYÊN MÔN PATH */
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, ''),
            (
                SELECT u.DepartmentPath 
                FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
                WHERE u.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser 
                ORDER BY u.Id DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            )
        ) AS dept_ban_chuyen_mon,

        t.Title AS ten_task,
        t.NameGroup AS nhom_nhiem_vu,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.Code, ''), CAST(t.TaskId AS CHAR)) AS stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.Title, ''), t.Content) AS noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

        t.StartedDate AS ngay_bat_dau,
        t.ExpireDate AS thoi_han,
        t.CompletedDate AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

        /* TÌNH TRẠNG */
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (3, 4) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo'
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND (
                     t.ExpireDate IS NULL 
                     OR DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                 )
                THEN 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                THEN 'Hoàn thành quá hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE())
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS tinh_trang

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

    /* CHECK LOG */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 1 AS has_user_dept
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        WHERE tu.DepartmentId IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
        GROUP BY tu.TaskId
    ) tu_check 
        ON tu_check.TaskId = t.TaskId

    WHERE
        t.DeletedDate IS NULL
        AND (t.Status IS NULL OR t.Status <> 5)
        AND t.TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1310', '490.698.1841')
        AND (
            (
                (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment
            )
            OR
            (
                t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
                AND (t.TargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
            )
        )
) b

/* VĂN BẢN GIAO */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        tr.TaskId,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(r.DocCode, '')
            ORDER BY r.ResolutionId
            SEPARATOR ' | '
        ) AS van_ban_giao
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
    INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
        ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    GROUP BY tr.TaskId
) rv
    ON rv.TaskId = b.task_id

/* LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ VÀ CHUYÊN VIÊN */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        x.TaskId,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT x.thong_tin
            ORDER BY x.Role, x.thong_tin
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien
    FROM (
        SELECT
            tu.TaskId,
            tu.Role,
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), '')
                    )
                ), ''
            ) AS thong_tin
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u
            ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t_sub
            ON t_sub.TaskId = tu.TaskId
        WHERE (
                  COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) = '490.698'
               OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE '490.698.%'
              )
          AND (
                  t_sub.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698%'
               OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE CONCAT(
                      CASE
                          WHEN t_sub.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                            OR t_sub.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                            OR t_sub.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                          THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t_sub.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                          ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t_sub.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                      END,
                      '%'
                  )
              )
    ) x
    WHERE x.thong_tin IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY x.TaskId
) ldcv
    ON ldcv.TaskId = b.task_id

/* BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp1.TaskId,
        rp1.Content
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(ReportId) AS MaxId
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max 
        ON rp1.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId 
       AND rp1.ReportId = rp_max.MaxId
    WHERE rp1.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp
    ON rp.TaskId = b.task_id

WHERE b.loai_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
  AND b.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định'

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    loai_nhiem_vu = VALUES(loai_nhiem_vu),
    hinh_thuc_giao = VALUES(hinh_thuc_giao),
    ben_giao_id = VALUES(ben_giao_id),
    ben_giao_name = VALUES(ben_giao_name),
    ben_nhan_id = VALUES(ben_nhan_id),
    ben_nhan_name = VALUES(ben_nhan_name),
    ten_task = VALUES(ten_task),
    nhom_nhiem_vu = VALUES(nhom_nhiem_vu),
    stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi = VALUES(stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    noi_dung_nhiem_vu = VALUES(noi_dung_nhiem_vu),
    to_chuc_dang_chu_tri = VALUES(to_chuc_dang_chu_tri),
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien = VALUES(lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
    ngay_bat_dau = VALUES(ngay_bat_dau),
    thoi_han = VALUES(thoi_han),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien = VALUES(tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien),
    ld_ubnd = VALUES(ld_ubnd),
    ld_van_phong_ubnd = VALUES(ld_van_phong_ubnd),
    ban_chuyen_mon = VALUES(ban_chuyen_mon),
    chuyen_vien_theo_doi = VALUES(chuyen_vien_theo_doi),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

relationships.description: FlowFiles that could not be updated are routed to this relationship

relationships.description: FlowFiles that have been successfully processed are routed to this relationship. This includes both FlowFiles that had text replaced and those that did not.

-- Bước 1: Tắt cơ chế merge subquery lỗi của MySQL 5.7
SET SESSION optimizer_switch = 'derived_merge=off';

-- Bước 2: Thực thi nạp dữ liệu chuẩn 15 cột
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_tongquan_ubndtp (
    task_id,
    ben_giao_id,
    ben_giao_name,
    ben_nhan_id,
    ben_nhan_name,
    loai_nhiem_vu,
    hinh_thuc_giao,
    cap_giao_nhiem_vu,
    lanh_dao_giao,
    ngay_bat_dau,
    ngay_het_han,
    ngay_hoan_thanh,
    nam_het_han,
    thang_het_han,
    tinh_trang,
    sync_date
)

SELECT
    b.task_id,
    b.ben_giao_id,

    /* 1. LẤY TÊN BÊN GIAO (SO SÁNH BẰNG CHAR ĐỂ TRÁNH ÉP KIỂU SỐ) */
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE CAST(d.id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.ben_giao_id, '.', -1)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_giao_name,

    b.final_ben_nhan_id AS ben_nhan_id,

    /* 2. LẤY TÊN BÊN NHẬN (SO SÁNH BẰNG CHAR) */
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE CAST(d.id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.final_ben_nhan_id, '.', -1)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_nhan_name,

    b.loai_nhiem_vu,
    b.hinh_thuc_giao,
    rv.cap_giao_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS lanh_dao_giao,
    b.ngay_bat_dau,
    b.ngay_het_han,
    b.ngay_hoan_thanh,
    b.nam_het_han,
    b.thang_het_han,
    b.tinh_trang,
    '${sync_ts}' AS sync_date

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.TaskId AS task_id,
        t.AssignDepartment AS ben_giao_id,

        /* PHÂN LOẠI NHIỆM VỤ */
        CASE
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ giao'

            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
                 AND (t.TargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ nhận'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS loai_nhiem_vu,

        /* HÌNH THỨC GIAO */
        CASE
            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') 
                    THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'

                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%' THEN
                        CASE 
                            WHEN tu_check.has_user_dept = 1 THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                            ELSE 'Không qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                        END
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS hinh_thuc_giao,

        /* CHUẨN HÓA BÊN NHẬN ID */
        CASE 
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN (CHAR_LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)

                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1307%' 
                         AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                         AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                         AND (CHAR_LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)

                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment
                END
            ELSE t.TargetDepartment
        END AS final_ben_nhan_id,

        t.StartedDate AS ngay_bat_dau,
        t.ExpireDate AS ngay_het_han,
        t.CompletedDate AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
        YEAR(t.ExpireDate) AS nam_het_han,
        MONTH(t.ExpireDate) AS thang_het_han,

        /* TÌNH TRẠNG */
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (3, 4) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo'
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND (
                     t.ExpireDate IS NULL 
                     OR DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                 )
                THEN 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                THEN 'Hoàn thành quá hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE())
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS tinh_trang

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

    /* CHECK LOG TASK_USER */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 1 AS has_user_dept
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        WHERE tu.DepartmentId IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
        GROUP BY tu.TaskId
    ) tu_check 
        ON tu_check.TaskId = t.TaskId

    WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND (t.Status IS NULL OR t.Status <> 5)
      AND t.TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1310', '490.698.1841')
      AND (
          /* Luồng Giao: từ 1814/1815 sang 490.698% */
          (
              (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
              AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
              AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.TargetDepartment
          )
          OR
          /* Luồng Nhận: từ 490.695% về 1814/1815 hoặc sang 490.698% */
          (
              t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
              AND (t.TargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
          )
      )
) b

/* CẤP GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        tr.TaskId,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(r.AssignOrganizationName, '') 
            ORDER BY r.ResolutionId 
            SEPARATOR ' | '
        ) AS cap_giao_nhiem_vu
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
    INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r 
        ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
    WHERE r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    GROUP BY tr.TaskId
) rv 
    ON rv.TaskId = b.task_id

WHERE b.loai_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
  AND b.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định'

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    ben_giao_id = VALUES(ben_giao_id),
    ben_giao_name = VALUES(ben_giao_name),
    ben_nhan_id = VALUES(ben_nhan_id),
    ben_nhan_name = VALUES(ben_nhan_name),
    loai_nhiem_vu = VALUES(loai_nhiem_vu),
    hinh_thuc_giao = VALUES(hinh_thuc_giao),
    cap_giao_nhiem_vu = VALUES(cap_giao_nhiem_vu),
    lanh_dao_giao = VALUES(lanh_dao_giao),
    ngay_bat_dau = VALUES(ngay_bat_dau),
    ngay_het_han = VALUES(ngay_het_han),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    nam_het_han = VALUES(nam_het_han),
    thang_het_han = VALUES(thang_het_han),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).
